## Definition of done

- [ ] Domain tests cover positive, negative, boundary, and transition cases.
- [ ] API tests cover status, Problem Details, authorization, and idempotency where relevant.
- [ ] Adapters satisfy shared contract tests.
- [ ] OpenAPI and examples match runtime behavior.
- [ ] Formatting, analyzers, build, tests, package audit, and secret scan pass.
- [ ] ADR, concept note, and learner exercises are complete.
